id: naive-now
message: "datetime.now() without a timezone is forbidden in shop/; pass a tz, e.g. datetime.now(timezone.utc)"

pattern: "\\bdatetime\\.(?:datetime\\.)?now\\(\\s*(?:None\\s*)?\\)"
# Skip lines where no such call sits outside a comment or string literal.
not-pattern: "^(?!(?:[^#\"']|\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')*?\\bdatetime\\.(?:datetime\\.)?now\\(\\s*(?:None\\s*)?\\))"
paths:

EOF
